text:
# Close wrap, Thu 2026-11-05

**Worst day since April 2025.** S&P 500 −4.32% to 7,353.65, Nasdaq −5.46% to 24,315.02 (confirmed correction, >10% off Oct 6 high), Dow −3.45% to 51,513.43. Nasdaq 100 −6.3%. Trigger: fears of tighter AI/data-center rules after the Democratic sweep plus soft QCOM (−9.5%) and ARM (−13%) results. NYSE breadth 355 up / 2,482 down ([Reuters via FinNewsletter](https://financialnewsletter.com/nasdaq-posts-biggest-daily-2/); [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/tech-stocks-plunge-ai-midterms-rcna607650); [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-lower-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-down-345-5005517)).

**Sectors:** SOX −12.3% (worst since Mar 2020); SNDK −22%, MU/WDC/AMD ~−16–17%, STX −16%, NVDA −9%, CSCO −7.9%, CAT ~−6%, GS −6.6%. IREN, APLD, CRWV, NBIS, GEV, CEG, TSLA all fell. KO, VZ ~flat, PG −0.4%. Brent +3.8%, WTI +2.7%; yields slightly lower; Dec hike odds eased to ~60% ([NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/tech-stocks-plunge-ai-midterms-rcna607650)).

**Winners:** EPAM +18.5%, CPAY +7.8% (record), TPR +6.2% ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-lower-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-down-345-5005517)).

**After hours (~4:30 PM ET):** ABNB +11% to $189 on Q3, raised FY revenue growth to high teens, Q4 rev guide $3.22–3.28B ([Airbnb](https://news.airbnb.com/airbnb-q3-2026-financial-results); [Public](https://public.com/stocks/abnb/after-hours)). NET −3.3%, DKNG −1.3% ([Public NET](https://public.com/stocks/net/after-hours); [Public DKNG](https://public.com/stocks/dkng/after-hours)).

**Tomorrow:** October jobs 8:30 AM is the swing factor. ABNB gap >5%: skip the open per rule.

**Signals:** AI-hardware/semis/data-center avoids extended to 11/10, added ARM, CSCO, CAT, GEV, CEG, APLD; MSFT hold pulled; expired avoids dropped.

## Swing idea
- **CPAY** long, low. Q3 adj EPS $7.54 vs $7.20, rev $1.38B beat; FY26 adj EPS guide $27.90–28.10; 2027 organic growth 9–11%; closed +7.8% at record $451.17 ([Corpay](https://www.corpay.com/corporate-newsroom/20621/corpay-reports-third-quarter-financial-results); [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-corpay-nyse-cpay-sets-new-12-month-high-on-strong-earnings-2026-11-05/)). Risk: gap logged in a crashing tape; fleet revenue tied to fuel prices.
